results.name: Liquid Glass Accordion
results.description: Liquid glass FAQ accordion with a real water pool: it stretches to the question you open, pinches like a drop and pours down into the answer. Drains back into the + when closed. WebGL shader with CSS fallback. Apple-style liquid glass, zero dependencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Liquid Glass Toggle
results.description: Liquid glass toggle with a real water drop: drag it and it stretches, snaps across and splashes into the track. Dark mode ready, sun/moon icons, WebGL shader with CSS fallback. Apple-style liquid glass, zero dependencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Liquid Glass Navbar
results.description: Liquid glass navbar with a real water drop: it stretches, splits into gooey droplets and merges back with a ripple. Animated icons, hover meniscus, WebGL shader with CSS fallback. Apple-style liquid glass, zero dependencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Liquid Sculpture Hero
results.description: Editorial hero with a 3D sculpture that turns into ~125k liquid particles under the cursor. Light/dark switch, mobile layout, WebGL2.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Elsewhere — Day/Night Video Hero with Ambient Sound
results.description: A full-screen video hero that switches from day to night with one click, with a live ambient soundscape generated in the browser: soft keys by day, cicadas by night. Nav, headline and two CTAs included. No audio files, no dependencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Sunset Skyline Hero
results.description: A full-screen anime-style scroll-locked hero: scrolling forward pushes the camera through a window onto a Tokyo skyline at sunset, scrolling back closes it again — ending on a giant Japanese brand mark behind a transparent skyline cutout, topped with a liquid-glass navbar.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Shave Reveal Hero
results.description: Interactive hover-reveal hero — drag a blade across a bearded portrait to shave it, with synthesized sound. Full light/dark theme support and keyboard navigation. Zero dependencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Scroll-Locked Video Hero
results.description: A cinematic, scroll-driven hero: the page locks in place and scrolling scrubs a fullscreen video forward and backward, frame by frame, with the title dissolving into blur as the reveal progresses. No dependencies, system fonts only. A memorable landing-page opener for portfolios
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Broken by Design — Shattered Glass Hero
results.description: Impact-fracture hero built from real shattered glass. Sixteen independent fragments per breakpoint react to the cursor with 3D tilt, parallax and specular light. The title is masked into each shard — physically broken across the pane. Fully responsive, zero animation deps.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: UFO Hero
results.description: A cinematic, physics-driven hero: a UFO drifts through end-credit text, pushing letters aside and burning them with its tractor beam on click. Fully responsive, built with a custom canvas engine. A memorable landing-page opener for portfolios and agencies.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Forma - Liquid Particle Studio Template
results.description: A React 18, TypeScript and Vite website template for design studios and creative agencies. Includes a WebGL2 liquid particle hero, particle headlines, grain image reveals and transitions, project pages, and light/dark themes. Static frontend; the contact form requires your own endpoint. AI-generated demo images are credited. The included buyer license permits unlimited personal and client websites.
results.author: gughigug

results.name: Villa Aurelia - Cinematic Villa Website Template
results.description: A cinematic Next.js website for villas and holiday rentals with scroll-driven imagery. Includes source, setup instructions, font licenses and AI-generated demo media. Demo media is fictional and must be replaced when advertising a real property.
results.author: gughigug
